register_model: register a model with an env_group_id, model_id, and entry_point in the global registry
make_model: make a model instance by looking up a registered model using env_name and model_name
load_entry_point: load a module and attribute from a colon-separated entry_point string using importlib
get_register_id: get the composite registration ID string from an env_group_id and model_id
review_registered_models: review the global registered_models dictionary to inspect all registered model entry points
